Only 2 new bespoke backdrops needed (`ticketCounter`, `trailerPorch` in a new small LOTTERY pack in src/stage.tsx) — the rest of the ladder composes entirely from DYNASTY (galaBallroom/familyVault/yachtDeck, repurposed from old-money to new-money's isolation and protection), MAFIA's courtroom (RICO trial re-narrated as civil nuisance suits, the 3rd episode to reuse it that way), SPY's safehouse (target wall re-narrated as a forensic accountant's tracing board), MED's consult, REALESTATE's openHouse, GEN's foundationScene, and universal templates. REAL grounding, web-verified this run: Powerball jackpot odds (1 in 292,201,338), the lump-sum cash-option haircut (~52% of the advertised jackpot before tax), federal withholding mechanics (24% auto / 37% top bracket), and the episode's central share-beat — the widely-repeated '70% of lottery winners go broke' statistic is NOT real (NEFE, who it's constantly misattributed to, has stated on the record it never produced it); the real peer-reviewed finding (Hankins/Hoekstra/Skiba 2011) is that MODEST winners already financially precarious before winning file for bankruptcy at a higher rate within 3-5 years. Three real, well-documented 'curse' cases (Jack Whittaker, William 'Bud' Post III, Abraham Shakespeare) were used ONLY as grounding texture, never as the protagonist, per the show's dramatized-composite convention. STRUCTURAL VARIATION vs the prior 2 episodes: MID-ACTION cold open (a tense standoff at the gas-station door, not flash-forward or aftermath), single rise-then-fall act two (not multi-cycle boom-bust or a steady climb), and a CYCLICAL ending that returns to the exact same counter/clerk and literally resolves the cold open (not a torch-passing handoff or one-door-left-open). 30 scenes, 2206 words, gate PASS 0 warnings, 11.8 min, silence beat (gap=1.4) landed correctly in the gap before the reversal scene (duck_music log confirmed) — a 2nd data point (after venture_capitalist) supporting the [[silence-beat-auto-pick-vs-writer-gap]] hypothesis that keeping dramatic gaps/dialogue roughly balanced between the first and second half keeps the runtime-nearest-50% heuristic aligned with the writer's intended scene. Also surfaced and fixed 2 real defects this run, logged separately: [[money-card-width-scales-with-sub-caption-length]] (a new root-cause finding) and a 3rd recurrence of [[template-must-be-registry-key-not-backdrop]] via [[template-registry-vs-backdrop-name-recurred]].
